PresetHistory.Conflict.zh: 该预设已有后续修改，暂时无法撤销或重做；现有预设已保留。
PresetHistory.Conflict.en: This preset has a later change and cannot be undone or redone yet. Existing presets have been kept.

PresetHistory.ExternalChange.zh: 预设文件已被其他实例修改。本次操作未写入，请关闭并重新打开浮绘以读取最新预设。
PresetHistory.ExternalChange.en: Another instance has changed the preset file. This operation was not saved. Close and reopen FloatCanvas to load the latest presets.
